### Goal
Fix currency rounding so JPY amounts have zero decimal places; pause PDF async-queue migration.

### Constraints and rules
Keep commits small. After changing `requirements/base.txt`, run `make license-check` from the repository root. Report exact test output. Defer Travis/GitHub Actions migration until currency work is complete.

### Key decisions and facts
JPY formatting is expected in `ledgerly/money.py`. Recent logging changes add `request_id` and settings-load metadata. Scheduler recurrence now combines dates and local times with `tzinfo` before UTC conversion, preserving wall-clock time across DST.

### Ruled out
Bare invoice-list contract, httpx 0.23 Stripe incompatibility, and further PDF migration.

### Progress
Logging tests pass. Full suite previously: `142 passed, 3 skipped, 1 failed`; the health-log expectation was fixed. Scheduler tests now pass (`8 passed`), including new midnight DST coverage. Currency fix remains outstanding.

### Next steps
Inspect `ledgerly/money.py`; update JPY rounding and focused tests. Run focused tests, Ruff, and the full suite, then commit the currency fix separately.
